Dave Matthews Band

Daily's Place
Jacksonville, FL

Tapers:			Henry Hart and his daughter Jacqueline
Source:			DPA 4011 + 4061 > Sound Devices MixPre-6ii
Location:		left stack, on the rail
Conversion:		Adobe Audition 2023 > CD Wave Editor v1.98 to .flac level 8
Mixing:			mixed a 4061 mic to center, mixed <125Hz to center, scooped the bass -5dB and raised the highs +2.5dB, normalize and fade in/outs
